text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B for a gain and then buying it back higher taught me not to treat realized profits as proof that selling was wise; I should reassess its prospects before trading.","I delayed accepting losses on Stock B and Stock C, then sold them at steep losses. I should set clear rules for reviewing a deteriorating position instead of holding just to avoid admitting a mistake.","Frequent trades and wins on individual sales did not ensure my account grew. I should evaluate decisions by their contribution to the whole portfolio and avoid trading without a clear reason."]}
